=
{
  "model": "moonshotai/kimi-k2.5",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are a specialized Mermaid.js diagram expert for the content pipeline. Your task is to transform the idea below into a production-ready, high-contrast Mermaid.js flowchart.

### STRICT SYNTAX RULES (violations will break the renderer):
- Start the output IMMEDIATELY with 'graph TD' — no leading spaces, no blank lines before it
- Do NOT use markdown code fences (no ```mermaid or ``` anywhere)
- Do NOT add any text before or after the Mermaid code
- NEVER use parentheses () inside node labels — use dashes instead
- NEVER use square brackets [] inside node labels
- NEVER use curly braces {} inside node labels
- NEVER use angle brackets <> inside node labels
- Node IDs must be single words with no spaces
- Stadium shapes must use this exact format: NodeId([label text])

### STYLE RULES:
- Include a %%{init}%% theme block at the top for dark high-contrast styling
- Use classDef to style nodes by category
- MUST include a Unicode emoji at the start of every single node label
- Use subgraphs to group related phases

### Output Requirements:
- Output ONLY the raw Mermaid code
- No preamble, no explanation, no markdown

Here is the Idea/summary:{{ $json.summary }}"
    }
  ],
  "max_tokens": 16384,
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "top_p": 1,
  "stream": false,
  "chat_template_kwargs": {
    "thinking": true
  }
}

={
  "model": "moonshotai/kimi-k2.5",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are a specialized prompt engineer for AI image generation models. Write one single image generation prompt — no explanation, no options, no commentary.

The image is a WordPress blog post featured image (hero image). Follow these rules:

STYLE: Flat design, bright vivid colors, contrasting palettes, clean minimalist, professional tech blog.
NO text, NO words, NO labels, NO people, NO faces.

COMPOSITION: Show relevant tech icons as flat illustrations, central focal element, supporting geometric shapes, 1200x630px landscape.

QUALITY KEYWORDS: flat illustration, vector art style, vibrant colors, sharp edges, high contrast, professional tech blog hero image, no text, no typography, clean background, 8k quality

BLOG TOPIC SUMMARY:
{{ $('Parse Pipeline Data').item.json.summary }}

Now write the image generation prompt:"
    }
  ],
  "max_tokens": 16934,
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "top_p": 1,
  "stream": false
}

parameters.content:
## Phase 1: Content Generation via RankReady SaaS
API: POST https://rank-ready-sag.lovable.app/api/generate
Returns SSE stream → collected into full HTML blog post

## Phase 2: Mermaid Diagram Generation
Nvidia Kimi → Base64 → Render → Upload to WordPress

## Phase 3: Featured Image
LLM Prompt → Image Gen API → Upload to WordPress

## Phase 4: Marketing Content + SEO Analysis
Marketing via Nvidia Kimi | SEO via RankReady /api/analyze
Content brief → Google Docs | Sheet update | Notification
